candidates.yourNature_desc: You still think past the horizon everyone else stops at. Bringing it back for people takes wind you don't always have, so whole coastlines of you go unreported. The sea does not shrink between crossings, whatever the calm looks like from shore. The few who've sailed far out with you know exactly what's out there.

self_card.presence: The water is as deep as it ever was. What varies is the crossing, not the water. No one measures an ocean by its calm days.
